name: GL_JE_ERROR_CODES
description: GL_JE_ERROR_CODES contains the error code of the journal lines.

columns.name: JE_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Journal entry batch identifier.

columns.name: JE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Journal entry header identifier.

columns.name: JE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Unique journal line identifier column.

columns.name: ERROR_NUM
columns.description: Number of error used to identify the row when there are multiple errors on a batch, journal, or line.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Journal batch. Foreign key to GL_JE_BATCHES.

columns.name: HEADER_NAME
columns.description: Journal entry name. Foreign key to GL_JE_HEADRES.

columns.name: ACTUAL_FLAG
columns.description: Balance type(Actual, Budget, or Encumbrance).

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Journal entry accounting period. Foreign key to GL_PERIODS.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE
columns.description: Journal source. Foreign key to GL_JE_SOURCES_B.

columns.name: JE_ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Journal entry error code, corresponds to lookup  GL_JE_ERROR_CODES.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Detailed description of the error.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the message that was used to generate the message text in the ERROR_MESSAGE column.

columns.name: PARENT_JE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Journal from which this reporting currency journal was created. Only populated in cases where the reporting currency journal will not be retained after the posting run is complete, due to a validation error.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ERROR_SEVERITY_CODE
columns.description: Severity of the validation error. Valid values are ERROR and WARNING.
